idea-plugin.name: Local AI Agent
idea-plugin.description:
Use locally installed coding agents inside IntelliJ IDEA.

Local AI Agent connects the current IDEA project to supported command-line agents, including Codex CLI and Claude Code. Work with streaming replies, tool activity, native permission prompts, and follow-up questions without leaving the IDE.

  • Add selected code, the current file, or a project-tree file to a conversation.
  • Choose the Agent, model, reasoning effort, and execution permission level.
  • Resume project-scoped conversation history and inspect saved context usage.
  • Detect, configure, install, update, and restart supported local Agent CLIs.
  • Dictate drafts with optional Tencent Cloud, SiliconFlow, or a custom speech service; configure and test it from plugin settings.
  • Inspect Codex turn diffs and open referenced project files in IDEA.
  • Follow the IDEA light or dark theme and switch between English and Chinese.

Requirements: IntelliJ IDEA 2024.1 or later with JCEF, plus at least one supported Agent CLI. The CLI must be configured and signed in before use. Windows x64/ARM64 and macOS Apple Silicon/Intel are supported.

The bundled service listens only on a random 127.0.0.1 port. Conversations and plugin settings are stored on the local machine. Requests sent by an Agent CLI remain subject to that CLI's configuration and provider terms. Optional voice input uploads recorded audio directly to the speech provider you select.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.1.22

  • Adds microphone recording and speech-to-text insertion at the draft cursor, without automatically sending a message.
  • Supports Tencent Cloud, SiliconFlow, and custom speech services with separate credentials stored in the IDE Password Safe.
  • Provides persistent voice configuration and recording tests, and shows the active provider in settings and the recording popover.
  • Shows expandable Codex turn diffs and opens referenced project files at their line in IDEA.
  • Includes Windows x64/ARM64 and macOS Apple Silicon/Intel runtimes; supports IDEA 2024.1 and later.
